research_notes: Follow-up: obtain school annual reports/departmental appointment lists for Darwin, Laverton, Galvin Park and Moonee Ponds, including substantive hours, leave and role transitions. Verify historical legal employer/control for Laverton/Galvin Park and exact Moonee Ponds appointment/resignation; investigate earlier jobs and teaching breaks.

Reviewed 2026-09-29 APH, first speech, 2008 role recollection, own profile, contemporaneous ABC report, Victorian government school history, ABN history and Darwin school history. Targeted school annual-report and 2011/2012 searches did not produce personal appointment dates.

Secondary accounts describe an 18-month principalship; do not back-calculate an exact start date without the underlying 2013 farewell report. APH says Central, speech says Primary: official 2013 name change resolves identity without creating two jobs.

2008 role presence is not a start boundary. Job seniority and lengthy teaching descriptions do not prove continuous full-time service. Years/FTE remain unknown; no totals calculated. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; partial initial record.
